# 🎮 Story Mode Full Game

**Experience Minecraft: Story Mode like never before in Minecraft Java Edition!**

This modpack is my attempt to recreate the feeling of **Minecraft: Story Mode** by combining dozens of Story Mode mods, resource packs, music packs, and quality-of-life improvements into one complete experience.

From the **Wither Storm**, **Command Blocks**, **Admin tools**, **Story Mode music**, **custom textures**, and **new gameplay mechanics**, this pack is built for fans who want to relive the adventure or experience it for the first time.

Whether you're exploring alone or playing with friends, this pack transforms Minecraft into a world inspired by Minecraft: Story Mode.

---

# ✨ Features

* 🌪️ Fight the terrifying Wither Storm
* 📖 Story Mode-inspired blocks, items, and decorations
* 🎵 Original Story Mode music and sound effects
* 🎨 Story Mode textures and visual improvements
* ⚔️ Better gameplay with new mechanics and quality-of-life mods
* 🌍 Multiplayer compatible
* 💻 Built for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

---

# ❤️ Made for Minecraft: Story Mode Fans

If you miss the world of **Minecraft: Story Mode**, this modpack was made for you. My goal was to combine as much Story Mode content as possible into one easy-to-play pack so fans can continue enjoying the adventure long after the original game.

Every mod and resource pack included helps recreate the atmosphere of Story Mode while adding new content to discover.

Thank you to all of the amazing mod creators whose work made this project possible.

**Have fun, and enjoy your Story Mode adventure!**
